item.title: Added · First batch of Pier & Point's own photographs, taken by Pierre Rohel on a walk through Mission Bay North and South on 2026-09-23 and 2026-09-24 and published under CC BY 4.0 with the credit 'Pierre Rohel / Pier & Point'. Each photo was placed on its record by the photographer on site. The hosted copies are resized and upright, with licence plates and recognisable faces blurred and all camera metadata removed except the credit and license. Nine of the 19 records had no record file before; each now has a minimal one carrying only what this project already recorded about it. Three more photos (rowhouses at 113-117 Berry St and the Mission Creek Senior Community at about 225 Berry St) are held back: neither building is tracked here yet.
